card.name: Middle of the name Edward
card.fires_on: The name Edward and the token right after it, such as a middle initial, a period, or the start of a surname, in citations and biographies. It also fires on the end of Édouard.

modes.label: Initial after Edward
modes.description: A middle initial or the start of a surname right after the first name Edward.

modes.label: Edward itself
modes.description: The first name Edward when a surname is expected next.
modes.example: argues<< Edward>> Lawler of the University of Southern California

modes.label: Period after initial
modes.description: The period following the middle initial in Edward M. Kennedy.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it seems to set up a name that comes next.
card.plain: It lights up on the name Edward and the middle initial or surname that follows it.
